# CT coronary angiography — Dr Eleanor Maitland (fictional)

Consultant cardiac radiologist at a fictional district general hospital; reports CTCA for the rapid-access chest pain clinic.
Voice: terse, label-style and line-per-fact. Fixed headers ending in a colon (Clinical details / Technique / Calcium score / Coronary arteries / Non-coronary findings / Conclusion); technique as fixed fields with numbers slotted in.
Per-vessel lines (LMS / LAD / LCx / RCA), CAD-RADS 2.0 band wording ("moderate (50-69%)"), "unremarkable" for branches and lungs, and a numbered conclusion ending in CAD-RADS category with P and HRP modifiers.
Management lines are stock sentences chosen by the worst lesion; a calcium-score-only study drops the coronary section, contrast and LAA statements.
